response.original_title: A Tour of the Universe Starring Earth & You
response.overview: A Tour of the Universe Starring Earth & You is a genre-bending, entertaining journey from the Big Bang to the human condition, with Al and Beryl as its human anchors. Combining cosmology, Earth history, evolution, comedy, narrative, mythology, philosophy, music, art and experimental imagery, the film explores how the universe went from chaos to consciousness—and somehow produced us.
